title: Separate authored changes from downstream impact
statement: As an architect assessing a change, I can distinguish Saga records the change edited from unedited records it may invalidate so I can review both direct and propagated consequences.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A comparison lists directly edited Saga records as added, revised, or retired, and a revised record includes its before and after representations.
The comparison lists unedited affected records separately and states whether each is affected by changed code, a changed revision pin, or a traceability-chain dependency.
